tools.name: search_plates
tools.description: Find progrss plates (sourced charts on how the world is shifting: power, economy, energy, technology, people, cities, planet, food, future) by keywords, e.g. "cobalt Congo", "India rice exports", "Japan births". Returns titles, URLs, sources and data years. Use get_plate for the numbers.

tools.name: get_plate
tools.description: One plate in full: title, subtitle, three takeaways, the data table, the original source with link and data year, claim types (Fact / Estimate / Interpretation / Forecast), the image link, and the credit line to use.

tools.name: get_numbers
tools.description: The verified numbers behind progrss plates, one per row: country or group, indicator, unit, period, value, claim type (Fact / Estimate / Forecast), and the original publisher, report, edition and link.
